name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible as users scroll or zoom, so they never hunt for meaning. The trade-off is less screen space for data, but clarity beats density—users reference legends rarely, but when they do, it must be instant.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky panel still steals 15% of screen at all zoom levels—users miss the data they came for. Instead, make the legend a floating, auto-collapsing icon that expands on hover or click, like Graphify’s graph. Settle it with A/B tests: measure time-to-task completion with each design—if the icon version isn’t slower, it wins.
